notes_for_editor: Agency not confirmed. The tnlandforms roster tags Willis TFS, and the same page's notes read 'Texas forest service TFS 91 towers', so the story only says the tag suggests that agency. The centraluslookouts Texas roster does not list Willis. Agency is kept out of facts except as the hedged agency_note. No build date, height, staffing or fate found in two searches and the roster pages. Brief coordinates and county match the list. Story is short, about 110 words, rather than padded. Checked 2026-10-21: the first draft said the roster does not spell out TFS, which the page contradicts, so that sentence was corrected and a new evidence quote added. Footnote [^1] was removed from the sentence saying no source describes the site today.
